from typing import Any

import reflex as rx
from reflex.vars import ObjectVar

import appkit_mantine as mn
from alloq_commons import theme
from alloq_commons.components.dialogs import delete_dialog
from alloq_commons.components.formatters import de_number
from alloq_commons.components.forms import section
from alloq_commons.components.modal_layout import (
    MODAL_CLASS,
    modal_footer,
    modal_form_layout,
)
from alloq_commons.components.toolbar import primary_button, toolbar_search
from alloq_commons.models import DailyRate
from alloq_commons.models.daily_rate import (
    MAX_CONTRIBUTION_MARGIN_PERCENT,
    MAX_PRODUCTION_COST,
)
from alloq_commons.state.daily_rate_states import DailyRateState
from appkit_ui.styles import sticky_header_style

COST_LABEL = "Herstellkosten"
MARGIN_LABEL = "Deckungsbeitrag"
PRICE_LABEL = "Empf. Verkaufspreis"
COLUMN_LABELS = ("Rolle", COST_LABEL, MARGIN_LABEL, PRICE_LABEL)
ROUNDING_HINT = "Verkaufspreise werden auf volle 10 € aufgerundet."
EMPTY_TEXT = "Noch keine Tagessätze angelegt."

_CURRENCY_INPUT: dict[str, Any] = {
    "suffix": " €",
    "thousand_separator": ".",
    "decimal_separator": ",",
    "decimal_scale": 0,
    "allow_negative": False,
    "allow_decimal": False,
}


def _euro(value: rx.Var | int, **props: Any) -> rx.Component:
    """Whole euro amount with German separators."""
    return mn.text(de_number(value, decimal_scale=0, suffix=" €"), size="sm", **props)


def margin_settings() -> rx.Component:
    """Card with the contribution margin shared by all roles."""
    return mn.box(
        mn.group(
            mn.number_input(
                label=f"{MARGIN_LABEL} (alle Rollen)",
                default_value=DailyRateState.margin_percent,
                on_change=DailyRateState.set_margin_draft,
                min=0,
                max=MAX_CONTRIBUTION_MARGIN_PERCENT,
                step=1,
                suffix=" %",
                decimal_scale=0,
                allow_negative=False,
                allow_decimal=False,
                clamp_behavior="strict",
                w=200,
                key=DailyRateState.form_version.to_string(),
            ),
            mn.button(
                "Übernehmen",
                on_click=DailyRateState.save_margin,
                disabled=~DailyRateState.margin_changed,
                size="sm",
            ),
            mn.text(
                COST_LABEL + " ",
                DailyRateState.cost_share_percent.to_string(),
                " % + " + MARGIN_LABEL + " ",
                DailyRateState.margin_percent.to_string(),
                " % = Verkaufspreis. " + ROUNDING_HINT,
                size="sm",
                c=theme.TEXT_MUTED,
                style={"flex": "1 1 240px"},
            ),
            align="flex-end",
            gap="md",
        ),
        style=theme.CARD,
        p="md",
        w="100%",
        max_width="1200px",
    )


def _preview_row(label: str, value: rx.Var) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.group(
        mn.text(label, size="sm", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
        _euro(value, fw="600"),
        justify="space-between",
        w="100%",
    )


def daily_rate_form_fields() -> rx.Component:
    """Role, production cost and the price preview of the rate modal."""
    return mn.stack(
        section(
            mn.select(
                label="Rolle",
                placeholder="Rolle wählen",
                data=DailyRateState.role_options,
                value=DailyRateState.draft_role_id,
                on_change=DailyRateState.set_draft_role,
                disabled=DailyRateState.is_editing,
                searchable=True,
                required=True,
                nothing_found="Alle Rollen haben bereits einen Tagessatz.",
                left_section=rx.icon("shield", size=16),
            ),
            mn.number_input(
                label=COST_LABEL,
                description="Kosten eines Arbeitstages dieser Rolle.",
                default_value=DailyRateState.draft_cost,
                on_change=DailyRateState.set_draft_cost,
                min=0,
                max=MAX_PRODUCTION_COST,
                step=10,
                required=True,
                key=DailyRateState.form_version.to_string(),
                **_CURRENCY_INPUT,
            ),
        ),
        section(
            _preview_row(MARGIN_LABEL, DailyRateState.draft_contribution_margin),
            _preview_row(
                "Empfohlener Verkaufspreis", DailyRateState.draft_recommended_price
            ),
            mn.text(ROUNDING_HINT, size="xs", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
        ),
        gap="md",
        w="100%",
    )


def daily_rate_modal() -> rx.Component:
    """Modal for adding or editing a daily rate."""
    return mn.modal(
        modal_form_layout(
            content=mn.flex(
                daily_rate_form_fields(),
                mn.space(height="2rem"),
                direction="column",
                width="100%",
            ),
            footer=modal_footer(
                "Tagessatz speichern",
                DailyRateState.close_modal,
                loading=DailyRateState.is_loading,
            ),
            on_submit=DailyRateState.save_rate,
        ),
        title=rx.cond(
            DailyRateState.is_editing, "Tagessatz bearbeiten", "Tagessatz hinzufügen"
        ),
        opened=DailyRateState.modal_open,
        on_close=DailyRateState.close_modal,
        size="md",
        centered=True,
        class_name=MODAL_CLASS,
        overlay_props={"backgroundOpacity": 0.5, "blur": 4},
    )


def _row_actions(rate: ObjectVar[DailyRate]) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.group(
        rx.icon_button(
            rx.icon("square-pen", size=16),
            on_click=DailyRateState.edit_rate(rate.id),  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
            variant="ghost",
        ),
        delete_dialog(
            title="Löschen bestätigen",
            content=rate.role_name,
            on_click=DailyRateState.delete_rate(rate.id),  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
            icon_button=True,
            color="red",
            variant="subtle",
        ),
        gap="xs",
        wrap="nowrap",
        align="center",
    )


def daily_rates_table_row(rate: ObjectVar[DailyRate]) -> rx.Component:
    """Render a single daily rate as a table row."""
    right = {"textAlign": "right", "whiteSpace": "nowrap"}
    return mn.table.tr(
        mn.table.td(
            mn.text(rate.role_name, size="sm", fw="500", style={"whiteSpace": "nowrap"})
        ),
        mn.table.td(_euro(rate.production_cost), style=right),
        mn.table.td(_euro(rate.contribution_margin), style=right),
        mn.table.td(_euro(rate.recommended_price, fw="600"), style=right),
        mn.table.td(_row_actions(rate), width="1%", style={"whiteSpace": "nowrap"}),
    )


def _message_row(content: rx.Component) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.table.tr(
        mn.table.td(
            content, col_span=len(COLUMN_LABELS) + 1, style={"textAlign": "center"}
        )
    )


def _header(label: str) -> rx.Component:
    align = "left" if label == COLUMN_LABELS[0] else "right"
    return mn.table.th(mn.text(label, size="sm", fw="700"), style={"textAlign": align})


def daily_rates_table() -> rx.Component:
    """Table of all daily rates with add/edit modal."""
    return mn.stack(
        daily_rate_modal(),
        mn.table(
            mn.table.thead(
                mn.table.tr(
                    *(_header(label) for label in COLUMN_LABELS),
                    mn.table.th(mn.text("", size="sm")),
                    style=sticky_header_style,
                ),
            ),
            mn.table.tbody(
                rx.cond(
                    DailyRateState.is_loading,
                    _message_row(
                        rx.hstack(
                            rx.spinner(size="3"),
                            mn.text("Lade Tagessätze...", size="sm"),
                            align="center",
                            justify="center",
                            spacing="3",
                        )
                    ),
                    rx.cond(
                        DailyRateState.priced_rates.length() > 0,
                        rx.foreach(DailyRateState.priced_rates, daily_rates_table_row),
                        _message_row(mn.text(EMPTY_TEXT, size="sm", c="dimmed")),
                    ),
                )
            ),
            sticky_header=True,
            sticky_header_offset="0px",
            striped=False,
            highlight_on_hover=True,
            highlight_on_hover_color=rx.color_mode_cond(
                light="gray.0",
                dark="dark.8",
            ),
            w="100%",
        ),
        w="100%",
    )


def daily_rates_toolbar() -> list[rx.Component]:
    """Toolbar actions of the daily rates page."""
    return [
        toolbar_search(
            DailyRateState.search_filter,
            DailyRateState.set_search_filter,
            "Rollen suchen",
        ),
        primary_button("Neuer Tagessatz", "plus", DailyRateState.open_add_modal),
    ]

from alloq_commons.state.daily_rate_states import DailyRateState

import appkit_mantine as mn

def create_daily_rates_page(
    sidebar: rx.Component,
    route: str = "/admin/daily-rates",
    title: str = "Tagessätze",
) -> rx.Component:
    """Page factory for the daily rates of the roles."""

    @app_page(
        route=route,
        title=title,
        sidebar=sidebar,
        toolbar=window_toolbar(
            "Tagessätze",
            "Administration · Herstellkosten und Verkaufspreise je Rolle",
            actions=daily_rates_toolbar(),
        ),
        admin_only=True,
        on_load=[DailyRateState.load_daily_rates],
    )
    def _daily_rates_page() -> rx.Component:
        return requires_admin(
            mn.stack(
                margin_settings(),
                mn.box(
                    daily_rates_table(),
                    style=theme.CARD,
                    p="xs",
                    w="100%",
                    max_width="1200px",
                ),
                gap="md",
                w="100%",
            ),
        )

    return _daily_rates_page

# ============================================================================
# Database Fixtures (SQLite In-Memory)
# ============================================================================


@pytest_asyncio.fixture
async def async_engine() -> AsyncGenerator[AsyncEngine, None]:
    """Create an async SQLite in-memory engine for testing.

    Uses StaticPool to ensure the same connection is reused,
    preventing SQLite from losing in-memory data between transactions.

    Creates tables from both appkit_commons.Base
    to support all model types in the test suite. ArrayType custom type
    handles both PostgreSQL ARRAY and SQLite JSON compatibility.
    """
    engine = create_async_engine(
        "sqlite+aiosqlite:///:memory:",
        echo=False,
        poolclass=StaticPool,
        connect_args={"check_same_thread": False},
    )

    # Create all tables from both metadata sources
    async with engine.begin() as conn:
        # Create appkit_commons.Base tables (appkit_user models)
        await conn.run_sync(Base.metadata.create_all)
        # ArrayType custom type handles both PostgreSQL ARRAY and SQLite JSON

    yield engine

    # Cleanup
    await engine.dispose()


@pytest.fixture
def async_session_factory(
    async_engine: AsyncEngine,
) -> async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession]:
    """Create an async session factory for the test engine.

    Configures explicit binds for both Base
    to ensure the session can locate the correct engine for any model.
    """
    return async_sessionmaker(
        bind=async_engine,
        expire_on_commit=False,
        autoflush=False,
        binds={
            Base: async_engine,
        },
    )


@pytest_asyncio.fixture
async def async_session(
    async_session_factory: async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession],
) -> AsyncGenerator[AsyncSession, None]:
    """Provide an async session for each test.

    Each test gets a fresh session that's automatically rolled back
    after the test completes, ensuring test isolation.
    """
    async with async_session_factory() as session, session.begin():
        # Start a transaction, automatic rollback on exit
        yield session

    async def test_save_margin_error(self, repo: AsyncMock) -> None:
        repo.save_margin_percent = AsyncMock(side_effect=RuntimeError("db"))
        state = DailyRateState()
        state.set_margin_draft(40)
        with _as_admin(state):
            text = await _run(state.save_margin)
        assert "Fehler beim Speichern" in text
        assert state.margin_percent == 35


class TestDailyRateComponents:
    def test_table_renders_priced_rates(self) -> None:
        rendered = str(daily_rates_table())
        assert "priced_rates" in rendered
        assert "recommended_price" in rendered
        assert EMPTY_TEXT in rendered
        assert all(label in rendered for label in COLUMN_LABELS[:3])

    def test_toolbar_has_search_and_add(self) -> None:
        assert len(daily_rates_toolbar()) == 2

    def test_cost_input_is_a_euro_amount(self) -> None:

        assert 'thousandSeparator:"."' in rendered
        assert 'decimalSeparator:","' in rendered
        assert "draft_recommended_price" in rendered

        rendered = str(margin_settings())
        assert 'suffix:" %"' in rendered
        assert "save_margin" in rendered

MODULE = "alloq_commons.state.daily_rate_states"


def _role(role_id: int, name: str) -> RoleEntity:
    entity = RoleEntity(name=name, abbreviation="", ramp_up=False, ramp_down=False)
    entity.id = role_id
    return entity


def _rate(rate_id: int = 5, role_id: int = 1, cost: int = 650) -> DailyRateEntity:
    entity = DailyRateEntity(role_id=role_id, production_cost=cost)
    entity.id = rate_id
    entity.role = _role(role_id, "Architekt")
    return entity


@pytest.fixture
def repo() -> Iterator[AsyncMock]:
    """Patch the repositories and the DB session."""
    session = AsyncMock()

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def _ctx() -> AsyncIterator[Any]:
        yield session

    mock = AsyncMock()
    mock.find_all_by_role_name = AsyncMock(return_value=[_rate()])
    mock.get_margin_percent = AsyncMock(return_value=35)
    roles = AsyncMock()
    roles.find_all_paginated = AsyncMock(
        return_value=[_role(1, "Architekt"), _role(2, "Entwickler")]
    )
    with (
        patch(f"{MODULE}.daily_rate_repo", mock),
        patch(f"{MODULE}.role_repo", roles),
        patch(f"{MODULE}.get_asyncdb_session", _ctx),
    ):
        yield mock


@contextmanager
def _as_admin(state: DailyRateState) -> Iterator[None]:
    user = MagicMock(is_admin=True, user_id=1)

    async def _user() -> MagicMock:
        return user

    login = MagicMock()
    type(login).authenticated_user = property(lambda _self: _user())
    login.redir = AsyncMock(return_value=None)

    async def _get_state(cls: type) -> Any:
        assert cls is LoginState
        return login

    object.__setattr__(state, "get_state", _get_state)
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        object.__delattr__(state, "get_state")


async def _run(handler: Any, *args: Any) -> str:
    """Drive a handler and return its toasts as text."""
    result = handler(*args)
    if hasattr(result, "__aiter__"):
        return " ".join([str(i) async for i in result if i is not None])
    await result
    return ""

    state = DailyRateState()
    state.roles = [

        Role(id=2, name="Entwickler"),

    state.rates = [
        DailyRate(id=5, role_id=1, role_name="Architekt", production_cost=650),
        DailyRate(id=6, role_id=2, role_name="Entwickler", production_cost=500),
    ]
    return state

After a backend hot reload the page may stay on old data until the next load event.

Drawers (2026-10-18): a screenshot right after a click shows the page before the websocket round trip, so a drawer looks "not opened". Use `wait_for` on drawer text first, then screenshot. The "Connection Error:" node in snapshots is Reflex's hidden placeholder, not a real error; login still works.

content.text:
I built the "Tagessätze" admin page. All checks pass: format, lint, typecheck and 1361 tests, with coverage at 89.9 %. I haven't seen the page in a browser yet, because the app isn't running here. I also didn't run the new migration, because your database host comes from a secret and may be a shared database. Run `uv run alembic upgrade head` before you open the page.

**How the numbers are calculated** (please check, your wording allowed more than one reading):
- The Deckungsbeitrag percentage is a share of the selling price. So at 35 %, the Herstellkosten are the other 65 %, and the price is HK ÷ 0.65.
- The recommended selling price is rounded up to the next 10 €. The Deckungsbeitrag in euros is then the price minus the HK, so HK + DB always equals the price.
- Example: HK 650 € gives DB 350 € and a price of 1.000 €. HK 500 € gives DB 270 € and a price of 770 €.
- Only the HK is stored. DB and price are worked out when the page loads, so changing the percentage updates all roles at once.

**What the page has**
- At the top, one setting for the Deckungsbeitrag that applies to all roles. It starts at 35 % and allows 0 to 90 %. It shows the split ("Herstellkosten 65 % + Deckungsbeitrag 35 % = Verkaufspreis") and has an "Übernehmen" button to save it.
- A table with the columns Rolle, Herstellkosten, Deckungsbeitrag and Empf. Verkaufspreis. You can search it, and edit or delete each row.
- A dialog to add or edit a rate. You pick a role (each role can have only one rate) and enter the HK as a euro amount like 1.000 €. While you type, it shows the resulting DB and price.
- The HK is entered in whole euros, from 1 to 100.000 €, like the project budget. If you delete a role, its rate is deleted with it.

**Where the code is**
- Calculation: [daily_rate_pricing.py](components/alloq-commons/src/alloq_commons/services/daily_rate_pricing.py)
- Data and screen logic: [daily_rate_states.py](components/alloq-commons/src/alloq_commons/state/daily_rate_states.py)
- Page parts: [daily_rate.py](components/alloq-commons/src/alloq_commons/components/daily_rate.py)
- Page: [daily_rates.py](app/pages/daily_rates.py)
- Migration: [2026_10_18_daily_rates.py](alembic/versions/2026_10_18_daily_rates.py)

The page also has an entry in the sidebar under Administration.

from sqlalchemy import ForeignKey, Integer
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column, relationship

from appkit_commons.database.entities import Base, Entity

DEFAULT_CONTRIBUTION_MARGIN_PERCENT = 35


class DailyRateEntity(Entity, Base):
    """Daily rate of a role; empty prices mean "not set"."""

    __tablename__ = "daily_rates"

    role_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("roles.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), unique=True, nullable=False
    )
    production_cost: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=True)
    sales_price: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=True)
    """Manual recommended sales price; empty means it is calculated."""
    list_price: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=True)

    role = relationship("RoleEntity", lazy="selectin")

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        """Convert entity to dictionary for Pydantic model creation."""

"""Database schema check of the desktop app.

Migrations run only on the server. A desktop app that does not match the
database schema must not write to it, so sign-in stops with a clear message
instead.
"""

from typing import Final

from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

KNOWN_REVISIONS: Final = (
    "fa67bc89de01",
    "ef56ab78cd90",
    "de45fa67bc89",
    "cd34ef56ab78",
    "bc23de45fa67",
    "ab12cd34ef56",
    "ff77aa88bb99",
    "ee66ff77aa88",
    "dd55ee66ff77",
    "cc44dd55ee66",
    "bb33cc44dd55",
    "aa11bb22cc33",
)
"""Alembic history this app version knows, newest first (a test keeps it
current). The app expects the newest one."""
EXPECTED_REVISION: Final = KNOWN_REVISIONS[0]


async def schema_problem(session: AsyncSession) -> str | None:
    """None when the database has the expected schema, else a message."""
    result = await session.execute(text("SELECT version_num FROM alembic_version"))
    current = result.scalar_one_or_none()
    if current == EXPECTED_REVISION:
        return None
    if current in KNOWN_REVISIONS:
        return (
            f"Die Datenbank hat den älteren Stand {current}, diese App braucht "
            f"{EXPECTED_REVISION}. Die Migration auf dem Server steht noch aus."
        )
    return (
        f"Die Datenbank hat den Stand {current or 'unbekannt'}, den diese App "
        "nicht kennt. Bitte die App aktualisieren."
    )

"""Price calculation of daily rates.

A contribution margin is a share of the selling price: with 30 % margin the
production cost is the other 70 %, so price = cost / (1 - margin). Prices are
rounded up to the next 10 EUR. The recommended sales price uses the minimal
margin, the list price the regular margin. A manual price replaces the
calculated one.
"""

from alloq_commons.models import DailyRate

ROUNDING_STEP = 10


def round_up_to_ten(value: int) -> int:
    """Round a whole euro amount up to the next multiple of 10."""
    return -(-value // ROUNDING_STEP) * ROUNDING_STEP


def price_for_margin(production_cost: int, margin_percent: int) -> int:
    """Selling price that yields the margin, rounded up to the next 10 EUR."""
    cost_share = max(100 - margin_percent, 1)
    # Integer ceiling of cost * 100 / cost_share in steps of 10, without floats.
    steps = -(-production_cost * 100 // (cost_share * ROUNDING_STEP))
    return steps * ROUNDING_STEP


def _margin(cost: int | None, price: int | None) -> int | None:
    if cost is None or price is None:
        return None
    return price - cost


def _share(cost: int | None, price: int | None) -> int | None:
    margin = _margin(cost, price)
    if margin is None or not price:
        return None
    return round(margin * 100 / price)


def price_rate(rate: DailyRate, min_margin: int, margin: int) -> DailyRate:
    """Copy of the rate with calculated and effective prices filled in."""
    cost = rate.production_cost
    calculated_sales = price_for_margin(cost, min_margin) if cost else None
    calculated_list = price_for_margin(cost, margin) if cost else None
    sales = rate.sales_price or calculated_sales
    listed = rate.list_price or calculated_list
    return rate.model_copy(
        update={
            "calculated_sales_price": calculated_sales,
            "calculated_list_price": calculated_list,
            "recommended_price": sales,
            "recommended_margin": _margin(cost, sales),
            "recommended_share": _share(cost, sales),
            "effective_list_price": listed,
            "list_margin": _margin(cost, listed),
            "list_share": _share(cost, listed),
        }
    )

"""Price calculation of daily rates.

A contribution margin is a share of the selling price: with 30 % margin the
production cost is the other 70 %, so price = cost / (1 - margin). Prices are
rounded up to the next 10 EUR. The recommended sales price uses the minimal
margin, the list price the regular margin. A manual price replaces the
calculated one.
"""

from alloq_commons.models import DailyRate

ROUNDING_STEP = 10


def round_up_to_ten(value: int) -> int:
    """Round a whole euro amount up to the next multiple of 10."""
    return -(-value // ROUNDING_STEP) * ROUNDING_STEP


def price_for_margin(production_cost: int, margin_percent: int) -> int:
    """Selling price that yields the margin, rounded up to the next 10 EUR."""
    cost_share = max(100 - margin_percent, 1)
    # Integer ceiling of cost * 100 / cost_share in steps of 10, without floats.
    steps = -(-production_cost * 100 // (cost_share * ROUNDING_STEP))
    return steps * ROUNDING_STEP


def _margin(cost: int | None, price: int | None) -> int | None:
    if cost is None or price is None:
        return None
    return price - cost


def _share(cost: int | None, price: int | None) -> int | None:
    margin = _margin(cost, price)
    if margin is None or not price:
        return None
    return round(margin * 100 / price)


def price_rate(rate: DailyRate, min_margin: int, margin: int) -> DailyRate:
    """Copy of the rate with calculated and effective prices filled in."""
    cost = rate.production_cost
    calculated_sales = price_for_margin(cost, min_margin) if cost else None
    calculated_list = price_for_margin(cost, margin) if cost else None
    sales = rate.sales_price or calculated_sales
    listed = rate.list_price or calculated_list
    return rate.model_copy(
        update={
            "calculated_sales_price": calculated_sales,
            "calculated_list_price": calculated_list,
            "recommended_price": sales,
            "recommended_margin": _margin(cost, sales),
            "recommended_share": _share(cost, sales),
            "effective_list_price": listed,
            "list_margin": _margin(cost, listed),
            "list_share": _share(cost, listed),
        }
    )

from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import Any

import reflex as rx
from reflex.vars import ObjectVar

import appkit_mantine as mn
from alloq_commons import theme
from alloq_commons.components.formatters import de_number
from alloq_commons.components.toolbar import toolbar_search
from alloq_commons.models import DailyRate
from alloq_commons.models.daily_rate import (
    MAX_CONTRIBUTION_MARGIN_PERCENT,
    MAX_PRICE,
)
from alloq_commons.state.daily_rate_states import DailyRateState
from appkit_ui.styles import sticky_header_style

COST_LABEL = "Herstellkosten"
SALES_LABEL = "Empf. Verkaufspreis"
LIST_LABEL = "Listenpreis"
MIN_MARGIN_LABEL = "Mindest-DB"
MARGIN_LABEL = "DB"
COLUMN_LABELS = ("Rolle", COST_LABEL, SALES_LABEL, LIST_LABEL)
PRICE_HINT = (
    "Preis = Herstellkosten ÷ (1 − DB), aufgerundet auf volle 10 €. "
    "Leere Felder zeigen den berechneten Preis; ein eingetragener Preis ersetzt ihn."
)
EMPTY_TEXT = "Noch keine Rollen angelegt."

_CURRENCY_INPUT: dict[str, Any] = {
    "suffix": " €",
    "thousand_separator": ".",
    "decimal_separator": ",",
    "decimal_scale": 0,
    "allow_negative": False,
    "allow_decimal": False,
    "min": 0,
    "max": MAX_PRICE,
    "clamp_behavior": "strict",
    "hide_controls": True,
    "size": "xs",
    "w": 130,
}

_PERCENT_INPUT: dict[str, Any] = {
    "min": 0,
    "max": MAX_CONTRIBUTION_MARGIN_PERCENT,
    "step": 1,
    "suffix": " %",
    "decimal_scale": 0,
    "allow_negative": False,
    "allow_decimal": False,
    "clamp_behavior": "strict",
    "w": 200,
    "on_blur": DailyRateState.save_margins,
    "key": DailyRateState.form_version.to_string(),
}


def margin_settings() -> rx.Component:
    """Card with the two margins shared by all roles."""
    return mn.box(
        mn.group(
            mn.number_input(
                label=f"{MIN_MARGIN_LABEL} ({SALES_LABEL})",
                default_value=DailyRateState.min_margin,
                on_change=DailyRateState.set_min_margin_draft,
                **_PERCENT_INPUT,
            ),
            mn.number_input(
                label=f"{MARGIN_LABEL} ({LIST_LABEL})",
                default_value=DailyRateState.margin,
                on_change=DailyRateState.set_margin_draft,
                **_PERCENT_INPUT,
            ),
            mn.text(
                PRICE_HINT,
                size="sm",
                c=theme.TEXT_MUTED,
                style={"flex": "1 1 260px"},
            ),
            align="flex-end",
            gap="md",
        ),
        style=theme.CARD,
        p="md",
        w="100%",
        max_width="1200px",
    )


def _margin_line(
    margin: rx.Var, share: rx.Var, manual: rx.Var | None = None
) -> rx.Component:
    """Small "DB 340 € · 30 %" line under a price input."""
    return rx.cond(
        margin,
        mn.text(
            rx.cond(manual, "manuell · ", "") if manual is not None else "",
            "DB ",
            de_number(margin, decimal_scale=0, suffix=" €"),
            " · ",
            share.to_string(),
            " %",
            size="xs",
            c=theme.TEXT_MUTED,
        ),
        rx.fragment(),
    )


def _price_input(
    value: rx.Var,
    on_blur: Callable[[rx.Var], Any],
    key: str,
    placeholder: rx.Var | str = "",
) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.number_input(
        default_value=value,
        placeholder=placeholder,
        on_blur=on_blur,
        key=key,
        **_CURRENCY_INPUT,
    )


def daily_rates_table_row(rate: ObjectVar[DailyRate]) -> rx.Component:
    """One role with inputs for its cost, sales price and list price."""
    role_id = rate.role_id
    key = role_id.to_string() + "-" + DailyRateState.form_version.to_string()
    return mn.table.tr(
        mn.table.td(
            mn.text(rate.role_name, size="sm", fw="500", style={"whiteSpace": "nowrap"})
        ),
        mn.table.td(
            _price_input(
                rate.production_cost,
                lambda value: DailyRateState.save_production_cost(role_id, value),  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
                key + "-cost",
            )
        ),
        mn.table.td(
            mn.stack(
                _price_input(
                    rate.sales_price,
                    lambda value: DailyRateState.save_sales_price(role_id, value),  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
                    key + "-sales",
                    rate.calculated_sales_label,
                ),
                _margin_line(
                    rate.recommended_margin, rate.recommended_share, rate.sales_price
                ),
                gap=2,
            )
        ),
        mn.table.td(
            mn.stack(
                _price_input(
                    rate.list_price,
                    lambda value: DailyRateState.save_list_price(role_id, value),  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
                    key + "-list",
                    rate.calculated_list_label,
                ),
                _margin_line(rate.list_margin, rate.list_share, rate.list_price),
                gap=2,
            )

    "decimal_scale": 0,
    "allow_negative": False,
    "allow_decimal": False,
}


def _euro(value: rx.Var | int, **props: Any) -> rx.Component:
    """Whole euro amount with German separators."""
    return mn.text(de_number(value, decimal_scale=0, suffix=" €"), size="sm", **props)


def margin_settings() -> rx.Component:
    """Card with the contribution margin shared by all roles."""
    return mn.box(
        mn.group(
            mn.number_input(
                label=f"{MARGIN_LABEL} (alle Rollen)",
                default_value=DailyRateState.margin_percent,
                on_change=DailyRateState.set_margin_draft,
                min=0,
                max=MAX_CONTRIBUTION_MARGIN_PERCENT,
                step=1,
                suffix=" %",
                decimal_scale=0,
                allow_negative=False,
                allow_decimal=False,
                clamp_behavior="strict",
                w=200,
                key=DailyRateState.form_version.to_string(),
            ),
            mn.button(
                "Übernehmen",
                on_click=DailyRateState.save_margin,
                disabled=~DailyRateState.margin_changed,
                size="sm",
            ),
            mn.text(
                COST_LABEL + " ",
                DailyRateState.cost_share_percent.to_string(),
                " % + " + MARGIN_LABEL + " ",
                DailyRateState.margin_percent.to_string(),
                " % = Verkaufspreis. " + ROUNDING_HINT,
                size="sm",
                c=theme.TEXT_MUTED,
                style={"flex": "1 1 240px"},
            ),
            align="flex-end",
            gap="md",
        ),
        style=theme.CARD,
        p="md",
        w="100%",
        max_width="1200px",
    )


def _preview_row(label: str, value: rx.Var) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.group(
        mn.text(label, size="sm", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
        _euro(value, fw="600"),
        justify="space-between",
        w="100%",
    )


def daily_rate_form_fields() -> rx.Component:
    """Role, production cost and the price preview of the rate modal."""

        section(
            mn.select(
                label="Rolle",
                placeholder="Rolle wählen",
                data=DailyRateState.role_options,
                value=DailyRateState.draft_role_id,
                on_change=DailyRateState.set_draft_role,
                disabled=DailyRateState.is_editing,
                searchable=True,
                required=True,
                nothing_found="Alle Rollen haben bereits einen Tagessatz.",
                left_section=rx.icon("shield", size=16),
            ),
            mn.number_input(
                label=COST_LABEL,
                description="Kosten eines Arbeitstages dieser Rolle.",
                default_value=DailyRateState.draft_cost,
                on_change=DailyRateState.set_draft_cost,
                min=0,
                max=MAX_PRODUCTION_COST,
                step=10,
                required=True,
                key=DailyRateState.form_version.to_string(),
                **_CURRENCY_INPUT,
            ),
        ),
        section(
            _preview_row(MARGIN_LABEL, DailyRateState.draft_contribution_margin),
            _preview_row(
                "Empfohlener Verkaufspreis", DailyRateState.draft_recommended_price
            ),
            mn.text(ROUNDING_HINT, size="xs", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
        ),
        gap="md",
        w="100%",
    )


def daily_rate_modal() -> rx.Component:
    """Modal for adding or editing a daily rate."""
    return mn.modal(
        modal_form_layout(
            content=mn.flex(
                daily_rate_form_fields(),
                mn.space(height="2rem"),
                direction="column",
                width="100%",
            ),
            footer=modal_footer(
                "Tagessatz speichern",
                DailyRateState.close_modal,
                loading=DailyRateState.is_loading,
            ),
            on_submit=DailyRateState.save_rate,
        ),
        title=rx.cond(
            DailyRateState.is_editing, "Tagessatz bearbeiten", "Tagessatz hinzufügen"
        ),
        opened=DailyRateState.modal_open,
        on_close=DailyRateState.close_modal,
        size="md",
        centered=True,
        class_name=MODAL_CLASS,
        overlay_props={"backgroundOpacity": 0.5, "blur": 4},

def _row_actions(rate: ObjectVar[DailyRate]) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.group(
        rx.icon_button(
            rx.icon("square-pen", size=16),
            on_click=DailyRateState.edit_rate(rate.id),  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
            variant="ghost",
        ),
        delete_dialog(
            title="Löschen bestätigen",
            content=rate.role_name,
            on_click=DailyRateState.delete_rate(rate.id),  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
            icon_button=True,
            color="red",
            variant="subtle",
        ),
        gap="xs",
        wrap="nowrap",
        align="center",
    )


def daily_rates_table_row(rate: ObjectVar[DailyRate]) -> rx.Component:
    """Render a single daily rate as a table row."""
    right = {"textAlign": "right", "whiteSpace": "nowrap"}
    return mn.table.tr(
        mn.table.td(
            mn.text(rate.role_name, size="sm", fw="500", style={"whiteSpace": "nowrap"})
        ),
        mn.table.td(_euro(rate.production_cost), style=right),
        mn.table.td(_euro(rate.contribution_margin), style=right),
        mn.table.td(_euro(rate.recommended_price, fw="600"), style=right),
        mn.table.td(_row_actions(rate), width="1%", style={"whiteSpace": "nowrap"}),
    )

    return mn.table.tr(

"""Tests for the daily rates (Tagessätze) administration."""

from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Iterator
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager, contextmanager
from typing import Any
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, MagicMock, patch

import pytest
from alloq_commons.components.daily_rate import (
    COLUMN_LABELS,
    EMPTY_TEXT,
    daily_rates_table,
    daily_rates_toolbar,
    margin_settings,
)
from alloq_commons.entities import DailyRateEntity, RoleEntity
from alloq_commons.models import (
    DailyRate,
    DailyRateSettingsUpdate,
    DailyRateUpdate,
    Role,
)
from alloq_commons.repositories import daily_rate_repo
from alloq_commons.state.daily_rate_states import (
    INVALID_MARGIN_MESSAGE,
    DailyRateState,
    _parse_euros,
)
from pydantic import ValidationError
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from appkit_user.authentication.states import LoginState

MODULE = "alloq_commons.state.daily_rate_states"


def _role(role_id: int, name: str) -> RoleEntity:
    entity = RoleEntity(name=name, abbreviation="", ramp_up=False, ramp_down=False)
    entity.id = role_id
    return entity


def _rate(
    rate_id: int = 5, role_id: int = 1, cost: int | None = 780, **prices: Any
) -> DailyRateEntity:
    entity = DailyRateEntity(role_id=role_id, production_cost=cost, **prices)
    entity.id = rate_id
    entity.role = _role(role_id, "Data Scientist")
    return entity


@pytest.fixture
def repo() -> Iterator[AsyncMock]:
    """Patch the repositories and the DB session."""
    session = AsyncMock()

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def _ctx() -> AsyncIterator[Any]:
        yield session

    mock = AsyncMock()
    mock.find_all_by_role_name = AsyncMock(return_value=[_rate()])
    mock.find_by_role_id = AsyncMock(return_value=None)
    mock.get_margins = AsyncMock(return_value=(30, 35))
    roles = AsyncMock()
    roles.find_all_paginated = AsyncMock(
        return_value=[_role(1, "Data Scientist"), _role(2, "Entwickler")]
    )
    with (
        patch(f"{MODULE}.daily_rate_repo", mock),
        patch(f"{MODULE}.role_repo", roles),
        patch(f"{MODULE}.get_asyncdb_session", _ctx),
    ):
        yield mock


@contextmanager
def _as_admin(state: DailyRateState) -> Iterator[None]:
    user = MagicMock(is_admin=True, user_id=1)

    async def _user() -> MagicMock:
        return user

    login = MagicMock()
    type(login).authenticated_user = property(lambda _self: _user())
    login.redir = AsyncMock(return_value=None)

    async def _get_state(cls: type) -> Any:
        assert cls is LoginState
        return login

    object.__setattr__(state, "get_state", _get_state)
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        object.__delattr__(state, "get_state")


async def _run(handler: Any, *args: Any) -> str:
    """Drive a handler and return its toasts as text."""
    result = handler(*args)
    if hasattr(result, "__aiter__"):
        return " ".join([str(i) async for i in result if i is not None])
    await result
    return ""


def _state() -> DailyRateState:
    state = DailyRateState()
    state.roles = [Role(id=1, name="Data Scientist"), Role(id=2, name="Entwickler")]
    state.rates = [DailyRate(id=5, role_id=1, production_cost=780)]
    return state


class TestDailyRateModels:
    def test_to_dict_includes_role_and_prices(self) -> None:
        data = _rate(list_price=1300).to_dict()
        assert data["role_name"] == "Data Scientist"
        assert (data["production_cost"], data["sales_price"]) == (780, None)
        assert data["list_price"] == 1300

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "data",
        [{"production_cost": 0}, {"sales_price": 100_001}, {"list_price": -5}],
    )
    def test_prices_must_be_positive_and_bounded(self, data: dict) -> None:
        with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
            DailyRateUpdate(**data)

    def test_update_without_prices_is_empty(self) -> None:
        assert DailyRateUpdate().is_empty is True
        assert DailyRateUpdate(list_price=10).is_empty is False

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(("minimum", "margin"), [(-1, 35), (30, 91), (36, 35)])
    def test_margins_stay_in_range_and_ordered(self, minimum: int, margin: int) -> None:
        with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
            DailyRateSettingsUpdate(
                min_contribution_margin_percent=minimum,
                contribution_margin_percent=margin,
            )


class TestDailyRateRepository:
    async def test_margins_default_and_can_be_saved(
        self, async_session: AsyncSession
    ) -> None:
        assert await daily_rate_repo.get_margins(async_session) == (30, 35)
        await daily_rate_repo.save_margins(async_session, 25, 40)
        await daily_rate_repo.save_margins(async_session, 28, 38)
        assert await daily_rate_repo.get_margins(async_session) == (28, 38)

    async def test_rates_by_role(self, async_session: AsyncSession) -> None:
        tester = RoleEntity(name="Tester", abbreviation="")
        architect = RoleEntity(name="Architekt", abbreviation="")
        async_session.add_all([tester, architect])
        await async_session.flush()
        async_session.add_all(
            [
                DailyRateEntity(role_id=tester.id, production_cost=400),
                DailyRateEntity(role_id=architect.id, list_price=1300),
            ]
        )
        await async_session.flush()
        rates = await daily_rate_repo.find_all_by_role_name(async_session)
        assert [r.to_dict()["role_name"] for r in rates] == ["Architekt", "Tester"]
        found = await daily_rate_repo.find_by_role_id(async_session, tester.id)
        assert found is not None
        assert found.production_cost == 400


class TestParsing:
    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        ("value", "expected"),
        [("1.120 €", 1120), ("780", 780), ("", None), (None, None), (950.0, 950)],
    )
    def test_parse_euros(self, value: Any, expected: int | None) -> None:
        assert _parse_euros(value) == expected


class TestDailyRateState:
    @pytest.mark.usefixtures("repo")
    async def test_load(self) -> None:
        state = DailyRateState()
        with _as_admin(state):
            await _run(state.load_daily_rates)
        assert [r.role_name for r in state.rows] == ["Data Scientist", "Entwickler"]
        assert (state.min_margin, state.margin) == (30, 35)
        assert (state.min_margin_draft, state.margin_draft) == (30, 35)
        assert state.is_loading is False

    async def test_load_error_shows_toast(self, repo: AsyncMock) -> None:
        repo.find_all_by_role_name = AsyncMock(side_effect=RuntimeError("db"))
        state = DailyRateState()
        with _as_admin(state):
            text = await _run(state.load_daily_rates)
        assert "Fehler beim Laden" in text
        assert state.is_loading is False

    def test_rows_list_every_role_with_prices(self) -> None:
        state = _state()
        first, second = state.rows
        assert (first.recommended_price, first.effective_list_price) == (1120, 1200)
        assert (second.role_name, second.production_cost) == ("Entwickler", None)
        assert second.recommended_price is None
        state.search_filter = "entw"
        assert [r.role_id for r in state.rows] == [2]

    def test_rows_follow_margin_inputs_while_typing(self) -> None:
        state = _state()
        state.set_min_margin_draft(35.0)
        state.set_margin_draft("")
        assert state.rows[0].recommended_price == 1200
        assert state.rows[0].effective_list_price == 780
        state.set_search_filter("x")
        assert state.search_filter == "x"

    async def test_save_cost_creates_rate(self, repo: AsyncMock) -> None:
        state = _state()
        with _as_admin(state):
            text = await _run(state.save_production_cost, 2, "650 €")
        created = repo.create.await_args.args[1]
        assert (created.role_id, created.production_cost) == (2, 650)
        assert (created.sales_price, created.list_price) == (None, None)
        assert text == ""
        repo.find_all_by_role_name.assert_awaited()

    async def test_unchanged_value_is_not_saved(self, repo: AsyncMock) -> None:
        state = _state()
        with _as_admin(state):
            await _run(state.save_production_cost, 1, "780 €")
            await _run(state.save_sales_price, 2, "")
        repo.find_by_role_id.assert_not_awaited()

    async def test_manual_sales_price_is_stored(self, repo: AsyncMock) -> None:
        entity = _rate()
        repo.find_by_role_id = AsyncMock(return_value=entity)
        state = _state()
        with _as_admin(state):
            await _run(state.save_sales_price, 1, "1.000 €")
        assert entity.sales_price == 1000
        repo.update.assert_awaited_once()

    async def test_price_equal_to_calculated_clears_manual_price(
        self, repo: AsyncMock
    ) -> None:
        entity = _rate(list_price=1300)
        repo.find_by_role_id = AsyncMock(return_value=entity)
        state = _state()
        state.rates = [DailyRate(id=5, role_id=1, production_cost=780, list_price=1300)]
        with _as_admin(state):
            await _run(state.save_list_price, 1, "1.200 €")
        assert entity.list_price is None

from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Iterator
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager, contextmanager
from typing import Any
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, MagicMock, patch

    COLUMN_LABELS,
    EMPTY_TEXT,
    daily_rates_table,
    daily_rates_toolbar,
    margin_settings,
)

    DailyRate,
    DailyRateSettingsUpdate,
    DailyRateUpdate,
    Role,
)

from alloq_commons.state.daily_rate_states import (
    INVALID_MARGIN_MESSAGE,
    DailyRateState,
    _parse_euros,
)
from pydantic import ValidationError
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from appkit_user.authentication.states import LoginState

MODULE = "alloq_commons.state.daily_rate_states"


def _role(role_id: int, name: str) -> RoleEntity:
    entity = RoleEntity(name=name, abbreviation="", ramp_up=False, ramp_down=False)
    entity.id = role_id
    return entity


def _rate(
    rate_id: int = 5, role_id: int = 1, cost: int | None = 780, **prices: Any
) -> DailyRateEntity:
    entity = DailyRateEntity(role_id=role_id, production_cost=cost, **prices)
    entity.id = rate_id
    entity.role = _role(role_id, "Data Scientist")
    return entity


@pytest.fixture
def repo() -> Iterator[AsyncMock]:
    """Patch the repositories and the DB session."""
    session = AsyncMock()

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def _ctx() -> AsyncIterator[Any]:
        yield session

    mock = AsyncMock()
    mock.find_all_by_role_name = AsyncMock(return_value=[_rate()])
    mock.find_by_role_id = AsyncMock(return_value=None)
    mock.get_margins = AsyncMock(return_value=(30, 35))
    roles = AsyncMock()
    roles.find_all_paginated = AsyncMock(
        return_value=[_role(1, "Data Scientist"), _role(2, "Entwickler")]
    )
    with (
        patch(f"{MODULE}.daily_rate_repo", mock),
        patch(f"{MODULE}.role_repo", roles),
        patch(f"{MODULE}.get_asyncdb_session", _ctx),
    ):
        yield mock


@contextmanager
def _as_admin(state: DailyRateState) -> Iterator[None]:
    user = MagicMock(is_admin=True, user_id=1)

    async def _user() -> MagicMock:
        return user

    login = MagicMock()
    type(login).authenticated_user = property(lambda _self: _user())
    login.redir = AsyncMock(return_value=None)

    async def _get_state(cls: type) -> Any:
        assert cls is LoginState
        return login

    object.__setattr__(state, "get_state", _get_state)
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        object.__delattr__(state, "get_state")


async def _run(handler: Any, *args: Any) -> str:
    """Drive a handler and return its toasts as text."""
    result = handler(*args)
    if hasattr(result, "__aiter__"):
        return " ".join([str(i) async for i in result if i is not None])
    await result
    return ""


def _state() -> DailyRateState:
    state = DailyRateState()
    state.roles = [Role(id=1, name="Data Scientist"), Role(id=2, name="Entwickler")]
    state.rates = [DailyRate(id=5, role_id=1, production_cost=780)]
    return state

    def test_to_dict_includes_role_and_prices(self) -> None:

        assert data["list_price"] == 1300

        with pytest.raises(ValidationError):

        assert DailyRateUpdate().is_empty is True
        assert DailyRateUpdate(list_price=10).is_empty is False

    def test_margins_stay_in_range_and_ordered(self, minimum: int, margin: int) -> None:
        with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
            DailyRateSettingsUpdate(

                contribution_margin_percent=margin,
            )


class TestDailyRateRepository:

    ) -> None:
        assert await daily_rate_repo.get_margins(async_session) == (30, 35)

        assert await daily_rate_repo.get_margins(async_session) == (28, 38)

        tester = RoleEntity(name="Tester", abbreviation="")
        architect = RoleEntity(name="Architekt", abbreviation="")
        async_session.add_all([tester, architect])
        await async_session.flush()
        async_session.add_all(
            [
                DailyRateEntity(role_id=tester.id, production_cost=400),
                DailyRateEntity(role_id=architect.id, list_price=1300),
            ]
        )
        await async_session.flush()
        rates = await daily_rate_repo.find_all_by_role_name(async_session)
        assert [r.to_dict()["role_name"] for r in rates] == ["Architekt", "Tester"]
        found = await daily_rate_repo.find_by_role_id(async_session, tester.id)
        assert found is not None
        assert found.production_cost == 400

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(

"""Tests for the daily rates (Tagessätze) administration."""

from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Iterator
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager, contextmanager
from typing import Any
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, MagicMock, patch

import pytest
from alloq_commons.components.daily_rate import (
    COLUMN_LABELS,
    EMPTY_TEXT,
    daily_rates_table,
    daily_rates_toolbar,
    margin_settings,
)
from alloq_commons.entities import DailyRateEntity, RoleEntity
from alloq_commons.models import (
    DailyRate,
    DailyRateSettingsUpdate,
    DailyRateUpdate,
    Role,
)
from alloq_commons.repositories import daily_rate_repo
from alloq_commons.state.daily_rate_states import (
    INVALID_MARGIN_MESSAGE,
    DailyRateState,
    _parse_euros,
)
from pydantic import ValidationError
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from appkit_user.authentication.states import LoginState

MODULE = "alloq_commons.state.daily_rate_states"


def _role(role_id: int, name: str) -> RoleEntity:
    entity = RoleEntity(name=name, abbreviation="", ramp_up=False, ramp_down=False)
    entity.id = role_id
    return entity


def _rate(
    rate_id: int = 5, role_id: int = 1, cost: int | None = 780, **prices: Any
) -> DailyRateEntity:
    entity = DailyRateEntity(role_id=role_id, production_cost=cost, **prices)
    entity.id = rate_id
    entity.role = _role(role_id, "Data Scientist")
    return entity


@pytest.fixture
def repo() -> Iterator[AsyncMock]:
    """Patch the repositories and the DB session."""
    session = AsyncMock()

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def _ctx() -> AsyncIterator[Any]:
        yield session

    mock = AsyncMock()
    mock.find_all_by_role_name = AsyncMock(return_value=[_rate()])
    mock.find_by_role_id = AsyncMock(return_value=None)
    mock.get_margins = AsyncMock(return_value=(30, 35))
    roles = AsyncMock()
    roles.find_all_paginated = AsyncMock(
        return_value=[_role(1, "Data Scientist"), _role(2, "Entwickler")]
    )
    with (
        patch(f"{MODULE}.daily_rate_repo", mock),
        patch(f"{MODULE}.role_repo", roles),
        patch(f"{MODULE}.get_asyncdb_session", _ctx),
    ):
        yield mock


@contextmanager
def _as_admin(state: DailyRateState) -> Iterator[None]:
    user = MagicMock(is_admin=True, user_id=1)

    async def _user() -> MagicMock:
        return user

    login = MagicMock()
    type(login).authenticated_user = property(lambda _self: _user())
    login.redir = AsyncMock(return_value=None)

    async def _get_state(cls: type) -> Any:
        assert cls is LoginState
        return login

    object.__setattr__(state, "get_state", _get_state)
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        object.__delattr__(state, "get_state")


async def _run(handler: Any, *args: Any) -> str:
    """Drive a handler and return its toasts as text."""
    result = handler(*args)
    if hasattr(result, "__aiter__"):
        return " ".join([str(i) async for i in result if i is not None])
    await result
    return ""


def _state() -> DailyRateState:
    state = DailyRateState()
    state.roles = [Role(id=1, name="Data Scientist"), Role(id=2, name="Entwickler")]
    state.rates = [DailyRate(id=5, role_id=1, production_cost=780)]
    return state


class TestDailyRateModels:
    def test_to_dict_includes_role_and_prices(self) -> None:
        data = _rate(list_price=1300).to_dict()
        assert data["role_name"] == "Data Scientist"
        assert (data["production_cost"], data["sales_price"]) == (780, None)
        assert data["list_price"] == 1300

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "data",
        [{"production_cost": 0}, {"sales_price": 100_001}, {"list_price": -5}],
    )
    def test_prices_must_be_positive_and_bounded(self, data: dict) -> None:
        with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
            DailyRateUpdate(**data)

    def test_update_without_prices_is_empty(self) -> None:
        assert DailyRateUpdate().is_empty is True
        assert DailyRateUpdate(list_price=10).is_empty is False

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(("minimum", "margin"), [(-1, 35), (30, 91), (36, 35)])
    def test_margins_stay_in_range_and_ordered(self, minimum: int, margin: int) -> None:
        with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
            DailyRateSettingsUpdate(
                min_contribution_margin_percent=minimum,
                contribution_margin_percent=margin,
            )


class TestDailyRateRepository:
    async def test_margins_default_and_can_be_saved(
        self, async_session: AsyncSession
    ) -> None:
        assert await daily_rate_repo.get_margins(async_session) == (30, 35)
        await daily_rate_repo.save_margins(async_session, 25, 40)
        await daily_rate_repo.save_margins(async_session, 28, 38)
        assert await daily_rate_repo.get_margins(async_session) == (28, 38)

    async def test_rates_by_role(self, async_session: AsyncSession) -> None:
        tester = RoleEntity(name="Tester", abbreviation="")
        architect = RoleEntity(name="Architekt", abbreviation="")
        async_session.add_all([tester, architect])
        await async_session.flush()
        async_session.add_all(
            [
                DailyRateEntity(role_id=tester.id, production_cost=400),
                DailyRateEntity(role_id=architect.id, list_price=1300),
            ]
        )
        await async_session.flush()
        rates = await daily_rate_repo.find_all_by_role_name(async_session)
        assert [r.to_dict()["role_name"] for r in rates] == ["Architekt", "Tester"]
        found = await daily_rate_repo.find_by_role_id(async_session, tester.id)
        assert found is not None
        assert found.production_cost == 400

"""Price calculation of daily rates.

A contribution margin is a share of the selling price: with 30 % margin the
production cost is the other 70 %, so price = cost / (1 - margin). Prices are
rounded up to the next 10 EUR. The recommended sales price always uses the
minimal margin; the list price uses the regular margin unless a manual list
price replaces it.
"""

from alloq_commons.models import DailyRate

ROUNDING_STEP = 10


def round_up_to_ten(value: int) -> int:
    """Round a whole euro amount up to the next multiple of 10."""
    return -(-value // ROUNDING_STEP) * ROUNDING_STEP


def price_for_margin(production_cost: int, margin_percent: int) -> int:
    """Selling price that yields the margin, rounded up to the next 10 EUR."""
    cost_share = max(100 - margin_percent, 1)
    # Integer ceiling of cost * 100 / cost_share in steps of 10, without floats.
    steps = -(-production_cost * 100 // (cost_share * ROUNDING_STEP))
    return steps * ROUNDING_STEP


def _margin(cost: int | None, price: int | None) -> int | None:
    if cost is None or price is None:
        return None
    return price - cost


def _share(cost: int | None, price: int | None) -> int | None:
    margin = _margin(cost, price)
    if margin is None or not price:
        return None
    return round(margin * 100 / price)


def price_rate(rate: DailyRate, min_margin: int, margin: int) -> DailyRate:
    """Copy of the rate with calculated and effective prices filled in."""
    cost = rate.production_cost
    recommended = price_for_margin(cost, min_margin) if cost else None
    calculated_list = price_for_margin(cost, margin) if cost else None
    listed = rate.list_price or calculated_list
    return rate.model_copy(
        update={
            "recommended_price": recommended,
            "recommended_margin": _margin(cost, recommended),
            "recommended_share": _share(cost, recommended),
            "calculated_list_price": calculated_list,
            "effective_list_price": listed,
            "list_margin": _margin(cost, listed),
            "list_share": _share(cost, listed),
        }
    )

production cost is the other 70 %, so price = cost / (1 - margin). Prices are

from alloq_commons.models import DailyRate

ROUNDING_STEP = 10


def round_up_to_ten(value: int) -> int:

    steps = -(-production_cost * 100 // (cost_share * ROUNDING_STEP))
    return steps * ROUNDING_STEP


def euro_label(value: int | None) -> str:
    """German euro text ("1.120 €"); empty for no value."""
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return f"{value:,} €".replace(",", ".")


def _margin(cost: int | None, price: int | None) -> int | None:
    if cost is None or price is None:

    return price - cost

content.text:
I reworked the Tagessätze page into a table with one row per role. All checks pass (1362 tests, 89.9 % coverage), and I checked the page in your running app.

**The 1.120 € problem:** the formula was already right. A new percentage only took effect after clicking "Übernehmen", and that was easy to miss. Now both percentages update the prices while you type and are saved when you leave the field. With HK 780 € and a Mindest-DB of 30 %, the Empf. VK is 1.120 €.

**How the page works now:**
- **Two settings:** Mindest-DB (default 30 %) and DB (default 35 %). The Mindest-DB can't be set higher than the DB.
- **Herstellkosten:** you type them in, and each value is saved when you leave the field.
- **Empf. Verkaufspreis:** read-only, always HK ÷ (1 − Mindest-DB), rounded up to the next 10 €.
- **Listenpreis:** the field shows HK ÷ (1 − DB), rounded the same way. If you type a different price, it replaces the calculated one and is marked "manuell". Typing the calculated value again, or clearing the field, brings back the calculation.
- **Margin text:** next to each price there is a small line like "DB 340 € · 30 %", so all rows stay one line high.

**Things to know:**
- **Database migration:** run `uv run alembic upgrade head` again. I changed the second migration after you ran it the first time, so your database may have an extra `sales_price` column in `daily_rates`. The app ignores it. You can remove it with `ALTER TABLE daily_rates DROP COLUMN sales_price;`.
- **Focus jump:** if you change the HK and press Tab straight into the Listenpreis of the same row, that field reloads with the new price and the cursor leaves it. Typing into a field otherwise works normally.
- **Not my change:** `tests/test_sidebar.py` has an edit for a version label in the sidebar. It's from someone else, and I left it alone.

The main files are [daily_rate_states.py](components/alloq-commons/src/alloq_commons/state/daily_rate_states.py), [daily_rate_pricing.py](components/alloq-commons/src/alloq_commons/services/daily_rate_pricing.py), [daily_rate.py](components/alloq-commons/src/alloq_commons/components/daily_rate.py) and the new migration [2026_10_18_daily_rate_prices.py](alembic/versions/2026_10_18_daily_rate_prices.py).
